name: m7-sweep
about: The compiler's run-time forms from sweep M7: vec3(), quat() and color() with no arguments are their defaults; a before hook on MR::getCurrentStageName that skips with a text hands the game a kept copy, read back by the mod's call as characters, and an after's -> r reads the game's own; a map keyed by a game enum writes a value with no name as its number in quotes and decodes back the same; clamp with lo above hi is a wrong call at its line, ending that frame's run only
